answer_1.quote: The Text Style transfer (TST) task is a form of controlled language generation. The goal is to produce fluent style-altered sentences from a given base sentence, while also preserving its style-independent content.

answer_2.quote: Evaluation for text style transfer includes checking for a) Style Transfer accuracy, b) Content preservation metrics and c) Fluency of output sentences.

answer_4.quote: Each human annotator was given a set of base sentences and asked to vote for which model produced the most appropriate corresponding style inverted sentences.
answer_4.guideline: The evaluation guidelines was formulated to consider which model a) successfully transferred the target style b) preserved the style-independent content and c) was overall fluent and grammatically coherent.
